execution_models.definition: marketable (taker) order; long-only: entry = BUY against the ask, exit = SELL against the bid of the PIT book state at execution_time; the fill = touch adjusted by the declared slippage model; no partial fills, no limit orders, no shorting (direction 'short' is refused)
execution_models.touch_source: bookTicker book record (type=book), latest with available_at_ms <= execution_time
execution_models.decision_reference_source: bookTicker book record, latest with available_at_ms <= decision_time

latency_models.justification: order of magnitude of one REST round trip from this host plus processing (collector clock probes measure RTT/2 = uncertainty_ms, about 130 ms), rounded UP to the collector sample grid (sample_grid_ms = 1000), the finest resolution at which book state can be reconstructed; not derived from any return
stress: 5x the base latency (slow decision loop / queueing / retry); equals the Tier-2 depth cadence; not derived from any return

slippage_models.definition: fill = touch exactly (declared zero slippage beyond the touch)

walk the PIT depth snapshot (type=depth, latest with available_at_ms <= execution_time) on the order side for order_notional: BUY spends order_notional quote across asks ascending; SELL sells order_notional / depth_L1_bid base across bids descending; s = side * (vwap - depth_L1) / depth_L1 (relative to the snapshot's own level 1, so book/depth snapshot timing differences never enter s); fill = book touch * (1 + side * s)
unavailable_when: depth TOO_STALE / MISSING / from previous run
invalid ladder (crossed, non-monotone, non-positive price, negative quantity, empty side)
order_notional exceeds the displayed notional of the side (never extrapolated)
slippage_models.supported_scope: displayed levels only: Tier 0 depth20 at 1 s cadence, Tier 2 depth10 at 5 s, Tier 1 depth10 at 60 s (as recorded in the run record sampling_profile)

fixed_stress_justification: X0-S1 is a small predeclared sensitivity set, fixed BEFORE any real-data inspection and never tuned: 5 and 10 bps per side are exactly the P2-D0 protocol slippage sensitivity (+0/+5/+10 bps per side, section 9 item 4) so P2-D results stay comparable; 25 bps (2.5 x the 10 bps fee unit) is a severe bound for a quote held over the slowest sampled cadences (Tier-1 book 10 s, Tier-1 depth 60 s) and for books thinner than the order. All ASSUMED; calibration needs a separately authorized real-fill comparison

stale_policies.source: the collector's own semantics read from the run record of the boot that wrote the record: semantics.stale_ms and sampling_profile.cadence_ms (SCHEMA.md section 3); defaults = SCHEMA.md values when a run record carries none. No threshold is derived from any return

book.TOO_STALE: quote_age_ms > hard limit (Tier 0: stale_ms.book_t0; Tier 1/2: stale_ms.book_t12_dead)
book.DEGRADED: quote_age_ms > soft limit (Tier 0: stale_ms.book_t0; Tier 1/2: stale_ms.book_t12_suspect); bookTicker is event-driven, so age <= soft limit means 'no top-of-book change received' (collector semantics), not staleness

depth.DEGRADED: quote_age_ms > the stream cadence (collector freshness class 'aging')

confirmation.MISSING: confirmation_gap_ms > 3 x cadence (the collector HEALTHY rule: no gap older than 3 x cadence)
confirmation.DEGRADED: confirmation_gap_ms > cadence (at least one boundary missing just before t)

states.DEGRADED: estimate produced, flagged; at least one soft rule fired
states.INVALID: fail closed: execution price UNAVAILABLE (never a favorable or fallback fill)

invalid_rules: from_previous_run (record of an earlier boot, or observed before ws_start)
stream_not_observing (latest health lists the stream and no newer record exists)
degraded_rules: quote_predates_connection_event (the selected quote was observed before the latest connection event of its connection: reconnect / rotation / stall)
clock_suspect (record flag or latest clock record)
informational_flags: gap_known_1h (a closed gap of the stream, available <= t, ended within 1 h)
depth_book_inconsistent (depth L1 crosses the book touch)
unchanged (no new update since the previous sample)
data_quality_policies.depth_rules: the same rules applied to the depth stream gate X0-S2 only (depth INVALID -> X0-S2 UNAVAILABLE; DEGRADED -> flagged)
data_quality_policies.load_level: conflicting duplicates (same stream and sample boundary, different content) fail the whole load (AmbiguityError); unsealed days are refused; segment SHA-256 / sidecar / manifest / record count are verified

refusals.reason: no trade prints (aggTrades are not captured), no queue position, no hidden/iceberg liquidity, depth is a sampled snapshot (1 s / 5 s / 60 s by tier) of 20 or 10 levels; an impact curve beyond the displayed-depth walk cannot be supported
no order-book event stream between samples; marketable orders are assumed fully filled within displayed depth, otherwise UNAVAILABLE
a future post-entry LABEL, kept distinct from slippage; not computed in X0
the collector persists the latest quote per sample boundary; quotes superseded inside a sampling interval are never observed
